limits: All cases are bounded local diagnostic runs, not accepted before/after optimization benchmarks.
CPU slowdown affects this host CPU; GPU execution is not throttled and no physical low-power device is represented.
Development and production Controls runs must not be pooled. Profiles and instrumentation add overhead.
Snapshot key and total timers nest style/control timers. Rasterizer and preparation wall times can overlap. Do not add nested or overlapping stages.
Queue-prefix completion includes earlier queue work and main-thread callback delay; it is neither isolated GPU upload time nor visible presentation.
Glass GPU times cover observed render passes only, excluding queue wait, texture-copy work and presentation.
Forced full CPU readback and Glass card-only mode are diagnostic interventions, not product optimizations.
recorded-rows-complete means the expected result rows exist; it does not assert the process exit code.
Raw JSON, traces and images remain at their evidence paths; this compact report retains hashes and summaries.
